digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership and legacy facade removal (RP-04)
propositions: An AST-based ownership gate must deterministically reject direct/aliased ambient configuration reads, environment variable access, backend property reloads, and credential reads outside approved composition seams, with path/symbol/access-kind diagnostics.

Synthetic test fixtures covering prohibited access forms, import aliases, newly registered names without owners, and expired migration exceptions must fail the ownership gate; clean approved fixtures must pass.
Both the ownership-direction gate and existing field-consumption gate must execute in make lint and CI, with parity tests failing if either invocation is omitted.

Generated documentation (config.md, security.md) must remain byte-current with schema and ownership registries, covering lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior-delta topics.

The real codebase must have no direct ambient config/credential reads, backend reloads, or configurable adapter defaults below approved seams; every config/credential name must have exactly one owner, and the legacy exception set must be empty with no glob patterns.

Legacy facades, switches, per-job SSM paths, ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after focused suites, bounded live canaries, and behavioral regressions pass; rollback retains the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
